Aisha: heads-up: deploy-bot paused staging promote. multipart upload timed out and cache lease stuck on runner-51.
Deploy-bot: Promote paused: staging/canary failed (upload-timeout + lease-hold). Manual unhold only.
Diego: logs: \[2026-03-22T09:10:12Z] runner-51: OOM killer invoked (pytest-worker)
[2026-03-22T09:10:15Z] uploader: completeParts timeout after 60s
[2026-03-22T09:10:16Z] cache: lease not released key=staging/pkg-9f2d
Marta: likely due to new test concurrency change. options: pin last-green, run lease cleanup + rerun single job, or rollback runner image.
Aisha: prefer cleanup + rerun first. Ben has a cleanup script. risk noted.
Diego: ran clean_stale_leases.sh --prefix=staging-, removed 2 orphaned leases. requeued job.
CI-bot: rerun job #998 -> failed (OOM).
Marta: rerun still OOM. initiating nodepool rollback to runner-image:v2026-01-30.
Marta: nodepool update done, job requeued -> success. artifacts uploaded and leases released.
Deploy-bot: staging/canary passed. Manual promote available.
Aisha: decision: do not pin. rolled back runner image and validated canary. I'll add release note and create follow-up ENG-RT-1502 to revert concurrency tweak and increase runner mem.
Marta: promoted and noted. monitoring next two canaries. :eyes:
